tool_info.command_line:
python - <<'PY'
import zipfile, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspaces/semio/semio/assets/semio')
zip_path=root/'metabolism.zip'
kit_json=root/'kit_metabolism.json'

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    tdp=Path(td)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path,'r') as zin:
        zin.extractall(tdp)
    semio_dir=tdp/'.semio'
    if semio_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(semio_dir)
    shutil.copy2(kit_json, tdp/'kit.json')

    tmp_zip=root/'metabolism.zip.tmp'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_zip,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for p in sorted(tdp.rglob('*')):
            if p.is_file():
                zout.write(p, p.relative_to(tdp).as_posix())
    tmp_zip.replace(zip_path)

print('rewritten metabolism.zip with kit.json and without .semio db')
PY
